notes: Directional (N=3, quota-bound both subscriptions). Focus set = the 4 new tasks (deadlines view #445, minimal-wire anchored reorder #444, log cadence #431/#433). cadence numbers are on the LOCKED neutral prompt (the round's mid-run task-prompt fix); deadlines/reorder numbers are the single-batch runs. verdicts.deadlines-view-first-contact: READS CLEANLY for the core triage. gpt-5.4-mini reads deadline-order most-overdue-first well (naive view 2/3, skill 3/3; filters 3/3 both) — the #445 view + skill teaching passes its first live test. HAIKU under-composes the deadlines FILTERS: it runs bare `deadlines`/`deadlines --overdue` and drops the extra constraint, so `--today ∩ --overdue` failed (claude-cli 1/3, claude-skill 0/3 — 5/6 fails were all `count 3 vs 2` = dropped --today) and one deadlines-view rep miscounted 8 (unfiltered `deadlines`). This is a model composition HABIT, not a skill-content gap — the skill lists --today/--overdue and states filters compose, and claude-SKILL did no better than claude-cli (worse, 0/3 vs 1/3), so a skill edit is not the lever.
verdicts.minimal-wire-reorder: NO SURPRISES — writes-reorder-today-anchored PASSED 12/12 across ALL FOUR arms. The #444 anchored `--in today --after` minimal wire lands the correct final visible order everywhere; grading on final todayIndex order inherently tolerates the MOVPLC/TODWIRE re-stamp disclosure (which rides data.placement.warnings[]). The naive arms discovered `reorder --in today --after` from --help.
verdicts.log-cadence: GRADABLE and correct, discoverability is MODEL-DEPENDENT. Haiku reads meta.logging.{cadence,lastLoggedAt} cleanly and the skill HELPS it (claude-skill 3/3 > claude-cli 2/3). gpt-5.4-mini struggles regardless of arm (1/3 both): it either INFERS the cadence from logbook item patterns ('daily'/'irregular') instead of reading meta.logging.cadence, or reads lastLoggedAt but mis-transcribes the ISO year (2024/2025 for 2026). The last_logged field doubles as a routes-to-meta-vs-infers-from-items discriminator (world's newest item stop 07-16 vs the seeded lastLoggedAt 07-19). No skill refinement: the skill already teaches meta.logging (SKILL.md L45); the residual is a small-model discovery/transcription habit + an answer-shape artifact.

skillRefinement: NONE. The deadlines teaching (#445) passes its first live test for the reasoning-capable subject; the observed failures are model-habit (Haiku filter under-composition — skill already teaches it, claude-skill did not beat claude-cli) and small-model answer-shape/transcription (gpt cadence), neither a skill-content deficiency. Mirrors the 0.14.0 write round's no-refinement outcome.
